title: Syllabus Overview
notes:
• Ecosystem ecology: Biotic/abiotic factors, species interactions, pond & forest ecosystem structures/functions, food chains, webs, trophic levels, ecological pyramids, productivity, carbon & nitrogen cycles, ecological succession.
  • Ecological Adaptation: Hydrophytes and xerophytes.
  • Ecological Imbalances: Greenhouse effect, climate change, ozone layer depletion, acid rain, biological invasion.
